# Descriptions
@@ 1
This spell allows the caster to determine if a particular location, object, or
person has any kind of connection with the caster’s fate. A connection with
the caster’s fate is anything that the caster would consider important to his
future.
@@ 2
Caster causes any fate, omen reading, or other such spells to fail on him when
tried.
@@ 3
Caster improves his luck for one action. This spell may only be cast once per
action that requires a die roll. The die roll has +1 added to it (and this
modification may make the roll openended). This spell may not be cast after
the dice are rolled, does not require any separate action or activity, and it
is considered part of the action that is being resolved.
@@ 4
Caster is able to determine the target’s remaining Fate Points. If the target
makes his RR, or cancels this spell, the caster will still know whether or not
the target has any Fate Points at all.
@@ 5
Caster places a blessing on the target. Target gains a special bonus of +10 on
his next action.
@@ 6
Caster worsens the luck of the target. The target suffers a special penalty of
-1 per level of the caster for all his actions.
@@ 7
Caster alters his own luck. After caster’s next action and dice roll are made,
he may choose which die is the ''tens'' die and which one is the ''ones'' die.
@@ 8
Predicts the most probable actions of the target in the next round; specifics
are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail on targets
or what spell). This results in the caster being able to declare his statement
of intent after hearing what the target has decided to do.
@@ 10
Causes the caster to be excluded from random rolls made concerning a group of
which the caster is a member. If the GM rolls randomly for the group
concerning encounters, surprise attacks, random spell effects, random choosing
of targets, etc., the caster is excluded from all such rolls, and his presence
does not affect his group’s rolls.
@@ 11
Caster causes terrible luck to come upon one target. Causes the target’s next
action to be resolved as if he rolled a 01.
@@ 12
Caster’s luck versus one spell is altered. Caster may re-roll any one RR
within the duration.
@@ 13
As Luck I, except roll is modified by +2.
@@ 14
Caster gains a Fate Point. This can only be done once per level.
@@ 15
Caster separates one target from destiny. This causes the target to lose one
Fate Point.
@@ 16
Caster alters his own fate. Caster can cause any one roll made within the
duration that is directly related to him to be re-rolled.
@@ 17
Brings good fortune to one target. Causes the target’s next action to be
modified by +d100.
@@ 19
As Luck I, except roll is modified by +3.
@@ 20
Caster gains a +1 per level bonus to the next Divine Intervention maneuver
that he makes.
@@ 25
As Boon, except for duration.
@@ 30
Brings horrible luck to the target. Causes all the target’s actions to be
treated as if he rolled a 01.
@@ 50
Causes the target’s next action to be resolved as if the target rolled a 100.
